highlights: in need of general cosmetic upgrading
summary: Situated within a pleasant residential development in the popular town of Newton Aycliffe, this first floor apartment enjoys a convenient position close to a wide range of local amenities, making it ideally suited to first-time buyers, investors or those seeking low-maintenance living.
description:
Newton Aycliffe offers an excellent selection of shops, supermarkets, cafes, leisure facilities and healthcare services, together with well-regarded transport links providing easy access to Darlington, Durham and the A1(M) for commuting throughout the region. The property is also within close proximity to nearby retail parks, scenic walks and recreational facilities, offering both convenience and lifestyle appeal. This one-bedroom upper floor apartment would benefit from some general cosmetic upgrading, once complete it has the potential to achieve around £600pcm giving a potential 14% yield. The apartment benefits from allocated parking and offers comfortable, easy-to-maintain accommodation ideal for modern living. Combining a convenient location with practical accommodation, the property presents an excellent opportunity within a well-established residential area.

ENTRANCE HALL Accessed via a UPVC framed double glazed entrance door, the entrance hall provides a welcoming approach to the property and benefits from stairs leading to the first floor accommodation.

LOUNGE A bright and comfortable lounge benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light, creating a warm and inviting living space. The room is further enhanced by an electric wall heater, providing comfort throughout the year.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a stylish range of high gloss wall and base units, offering a modern and contemporary finish together with ample storage space. Complemented by laminate work surfaces and tiling to the splashback and preparation areas, the room is both practical and easy to maintain. Features include an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, integrated oven and hob, plumbing for an automatic washing machine, and space for a fridge freezer. A UPVC framed double glazed window allows for plenty of natural light, creating a bright and functional kitchen space ideal for everyday living.

BEDROOM ONE A well-proportioned and comfortable double bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light, creating a bright and relaxing atmosphere. The room is further enhanced by an electric wall heater, providing warmth and comfort throughout the year.

BATHROOM Fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath with inset electric shower over, wash hand basin and WC, the bathroom offers a practical space. Tiling to the splashback and vanity areas provides a clean and contemporary finish, while a wall-mounted electric heater ensures comfort and warmth throughout the year.
